This is the estate of the three Elway sisters. Although it has fallen into disrepair, both the house and the family that holds it have a very long history in Kilcairn.

A rare bust called the Warburg Effigy is being held at the Guildhall for safekeeping. Tonight there is a {MatchDurationInMinutes} minute window when security will be light. Steal the bust, embarrass the police, and turn a tidy profit.

The Claymur Urns have been held by the Elway family for centuries. The Guild will pay handsomely if you retrieve the full set. You have a {MatchDurationInMinutes} minute window to pilfer the Urns and make your escape.
The Constables' Guildhall is full of confiscated treasures. Infiltrate the building and reacquire some of the riches they have just left lying around, then slip away before anyone notices.

The Elway family has a magical tome they keep under the utmost protection in a vault. Tonight you will have a {MatchDurationInMinutes} minute window when security is light. Find the book, steal it, and get out alive.

The precious gems needed to restore an artifact are hidden among the trinkets gathering dust in the Guildhall. You have a {MatchDurationInMinutes} minute window to pilfer the gems from under the very noses of the police.

Though both the Elway family and their estate are a shadow of what they once were, there are still ample treasures to be found. Get in, steal everything you can, and get out before anyone is the wiser.
